# The catalog of data kinds for Foundation

> **Archived on 2026-10-28. Superseded by part 2 of [`FOUNDATION-DATA-ARCHITECTURE-PLAN.md`](../FOUNDATION-DATA-ARCHITECTURE-PLAN.md).** The meeting of 2026-10-27 rejected these 66 fine kinds. `catalog/build_catalog.py` does not write this line, so a new run removes it. Kept for the record only.

**Status:** a draft design, 2026-10-26. Nothing in it is built. Generated by `docs/catalog/build_catalog.py`, which also writes the registry `docs/catalog/data-kinds.json`. Do not edit this file by hand: change the script and run it again.

## What this is

Every kind of locale data that Foundation needs, defined up front, with its final name, its key, its keys inside (attributes), its source, the API that uses it, and the user setting that selects it. Engineers use these kinds. Users choose only features, calendars and locales (section "User settings"), and never see a name.

**Scope:** swift-foundation (the open source Foundation), at commit `662eac61` of 2026-10-26. The list of features comes from every ICU call in `Sources/FoundationInternationalization` and `Sources/FoundationEssentials`: 188 ICU functions in 28 ICU services. Section "Not covered" lists the features that only the Darwin Foundation has.

**Size:** 66 kinds by definition. 7 of them exist once for each data calendar, so the registry has 200 entries: 141 for calendars and 59 shared. By key: 171 keyed by locale, 23 keyed by none, 6 keyed by region.

## How to read a name

`<Feature><Data><Item>[<Calendar>]V<version>`. Each part is one word from a fixed list:

| Part | Words |
|---|---|
| Feature | Date, Calendar, RelativeDate, Duration, TimeZone, Number, Currency, Unit, List, Plural, LocaleName, Locale, Collation, Text, URL, Encoding |
| Data | Names, Patterns, Symbols, Rules, Info, Tables |
| Item | a list for each feature, see the tables |
| Calendar | a data calendar, see "Calendars" |
| Version | 1 for all kinds now. A new table layout gets a new version. |

Example: `DateNamesMonthChineseV1` = Date, Names, Month, Chinese, version 1 = the month names of the Chinese calendar.

**Keys.** `locale`: one value for each locale, found with the locale fallback (`fr-CA`, `fr`, root). `region`: one value for each region. `none`: one value for everything. **Attributes** are keys inside a kind that the code chooses at run time, such as a width.

**Split rules** (`DESIGN-DATA-KINDS.md`, section 5): 1 = a separate function of the API, so the linker can remove it. 2 = a build can leave it out, for example a calendar. 4 = always used together. A choice at run time inside one function is an attribute (rule 3), never a separate kind.

## Calendars

Foundation has 27 calendar identifiers. They share the data of 23 data calendars:

| Data calendar | Foundation identifiers | Data name | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Gregorian | `.gregorian`, `.iso8601` | `gregorian` | public CLDR |
| Buddhist | `.buddhist` | `buddhist` | public CLDR |
| Chinese | `.chinese` | `chinese` | public CLDR |
| Coptic | `.coptic` | `coptic` | public CLDR |
| Dangi | `.dangi` | `dangi` | public CLDR |
| Ethiopic | `.ethiopicAmeteMihret` | `ethiopic` | public CLDR |
| EthiopicAmeteAlem | `.ethiopicAmeteAlem` | `ethiopic-amete-alem` | public CLDR |
| Hebrew | `.hebrew` | `hebrew` | public CLDR |
| Indian | `.indian` | `indian` | public CLDR |
| Islamic | `.islamic`, `.islamicCivil`, `.islamicTabular`, `.islamicUmmAlQura` | `islamic` | public CLDR |
| Japanese | `.japanese` | `japanese` | public CLDR |
| Persian | `.persian` | `persian` | public CLDR |
| Roc | `.republicOfChina` | `roc` | public CLDR |
| Bangla | `.bangla` | `bangla` | **not in public CLDR**: Apple's data (to check) |
| Gujarati | `.gujarati` | `gujarati` | **not in public CLDR**: Apple's data (to check) |
| Kannada | `.kannada` | `kannada` | **not in public CLDR**: Apple's data (to check) |
| Malayalam | `.malayalam` | `malayalam` | **not in public CLDR**: Apple's data (to check) |
| Marathi | `.marathi` | `marathi` | **not in public CLDR**: Apple's data (to check) |
| Odia | `.odia` | `odia` | **not in public CLDR**: Apple's data (to check) |
| Tamil | `.tamil` | `tamil` | **not in public CLDR**: Apple's data (to check) |
| Telugu | `.telugu` | `telugu` | **not in public CLDR**: Apple's data (to check) |
| Vikram | `.vikram` | `vikram` | **not in public CLDR**: Apple's data (to check) |
| Vietnamese | `.vietnamese` | `vietnamese` | **not in public CLDR**: Apple's data (to check) |

Calendar arithmetic needs data only for the Japanese eras and Umm al-Qura. The other calendars compute their dates in code (Foundation already has Swift code for most of them).

## The kinds for each calendar

Each of these exists once for each data calendar. `DateNamesCyclic` exists only for Chinese, Dangi, Vietnamese. Each kind holds the complete data of its calendar, with the CLDR inheritance already resolved, as in ICU4X.

| Name | Content | Key | Attributes | Source (CLDR) | Used by | ICU4X | Rule | Setting |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DateNamesMonth<Calendar>V1` | Month names | locale | context (format, standalone) x width (abbreviated, wide, narrow), month patterns for leap months | dates/calendars/<cal>/months, monthPatterns | Date.FormatStyle, Date.VerbatimFormatStyle, parse strategies (udat) | DatetimeNamesMonth<Cal>V1 | 2 | dates, calendar |
| `DateNamesEra<Calendar>V1` | Era names | locale | width (abbreviated, wide, narrow) | dates/calendars/<cal>/eras | Date.FormatStyle era field (udat) | DatetimeNamesYear<Cal>V1 (with cyclic years) | 2 | dates, calendar |
| `DateNamesCyclic<Calendar>V1` | Cyclic year names, only for the calendars in CYCLIC_CALENDARS | locale | set (years, zodiacs) x width | dates/calendars/<cal>/cyclicNameSets | Date.FormatStyle cyclicYear field (udat) | DatetimeNamesYear<Cal>V1 (with era names) | 2 | dates, calendar |
| `DatePatternsStyle<Calendar>V1` | The date and time patterns of each style | locale | date or time x style (full, long, medium, short) | dates/calendars/<cal>/dateFormats, timeFormats | Date.FormatStyle with date and time styles (udat) | none (ICU4X has no styles) | 2 | dates, calendar |
| `DatePatternsSkeleton<Calendar>V1` | Skeleton to pattern tables of the pattern generator | locale | skeleton, append items | dates/calendars/<cal>/dateTimeFormats/availableFormats, appendItems | Date.FormatStyle with fields, Date.FormatString (udatpg_getBestPatternWithOptions) | none (ICU4X uses semantic skeletons: DatetimePatternsDate<Cal>V1) | 2 | dates, calendar |
| `DatePatternsGlue<Calendar>V1` | How a date and a time join | locale | style (full, long, medium, short) x variant (standard, atTime) | dates/calendars/<cal>/dateTimeFormats | Date.FormatStyle with a date and a time (udat) | DatetimePatternsGlueV1 (one for all calendars) | 2 | dates, calendar |
| `DatePatternsInterval<Calendar>V1` | Date interval patterns | locale | skeleton x greatest difference, fallback | dates/calendars/<cal>/dateTimeFormats/intervalFormats | Date.IntervalFormatStyle (udtitvfmt) | DatetimePatternsRangeDate<Cal>V1 | 1, 2 | date-intervals, calendar |

## User settings

A user chooses three things. A tool turns them into kinds, with this table and the registry.

* **locales:** the locales of the app (or its `.lproj` folders). Every kind keyed by `locale` keeps only these locales and their fallback locales. Kinds keyed by `region` or `none` stay whole: they are small.
* **calendars:** the data calendars that the app needs. The kinds for each calendar keep only these calendars. Default: Gregorian.
* **features:** the features below. Each feature also brings the features that it needs.

| Setting | What it is for | Also needs | Kinds |
|---|---|---|---|
| `core` | always in the build: the locale fallback, calendar rules, digits, time zone IDs and offsets | nothing | `CalendarRulesWeekV1`, `CalendarRulesPreferenceV1`, `TimeZoneInfoAliasesV1`, `TimeZoneRulesTransitionsV1`, `NumberSymbolsDecimalV1`, `NumberInfoNumberingSystemsV1`, `CurrencyInfoRegionV1`, `CurrencyInfoCodesV1`, `UnitInfoPreferenceV1`, `UnitInfoMeasurementSystemV1`, `LocaleInfoLikelySubtagsV1`, `LocaleInfoParentsV1`, `LocaleInfoAliasesV1`, `LocaleInfoAvailableV1`, `LocaleInfoLayoutV1`, `TextInfoBidiClassV1` |
| `dates` | Date.FormatStyle, Date.VerbatimFormatStyle, Date.FormatString | core, plurals | `DateNamesCyclic<Calendar>V1`, `DateNamesEra<Calendar>V1`, `DateNamesMonth<Calendar>V1`, `DatePatternsGlue<Calendar>V1`, `DatePatternsSkeleton<Calendar>V1`, `DatePatternsStyle<Calendar>V1`, `DateNamesWeekdayV1`, `DateNamesQuarterV1`, `DateNamesDayPeriodV1`, `DateNamesFieldV1`, `DateRulesHourCycleV1`, `DateRulesContextV1` |
| `date-intervals` | Date.IntervalFormatStyle | dates | `DatePatternsInterval<Calendar>V1` |
| `date-parsing` | Date.ParseStrategy and lenient number parsing | dates | `DateRulesParseV1` |
| `relative-dates` | Date.RelativeFormatStyle, Date.AnchoredRelativeFormatStyle | dates, numbers, plurals | `RelativeDatePatternsUnitV1` |
| `durations` | Duration.TimeFormatStyle, Duration.UnitsFormatStyle | numbers, plurals, lists | `DurationPatternsTimeV1`, `UnitNamesDurationV1` |
| `time-zone-names` | TimeZone.localizedName, and time zone fields in dates | core | `TimeZoneNamesFormatsV1`, `TimeZoneNamesMetazoneV1`, `TimeZoneNamesZoneV1`, `TimeZoneInfoMetazoneMapV1` |
| `numbers` | IntegerFormatStyle, FloatingPointFormatStyle, Decimal.FormatStyle and their parse strategies | core, plurals | `NumberPatternsDecimalV1`, `NumberPatternsCompactV1` |
| `algorithmic-numbers` | numbers in algorithmic numbering systems, such as -u-nu-hebr | numbers | `NumberRulesAlgorithmicV1` |
| `currencies` | the currency format styles, and currency names | numbers, plurals | `CurrencyNamesDisplayV1`, `CurrencyPatternsFormatV1`, `CurrencyInfoFractionsV1` |
| `byte-counts` | ByteCountFormatStyle | numbers, plurals | `UnitNamesDigitalV1` |
| `lists` | ListFormatStyle | core | `ListPatternsJoinV1` |
| `plurals` | plural rules, used by other features | core | `PluralRulesCardinalV1` |
| `locale-names` | the localizedString(for...) methods of Locale | core, currencies | `LocaleNameNamesLanguageV1`, `LocaleNameNamesScriptV1`, `LocaleNameNamesRegionV1`, `LocaleNameNamesVariantV1`, `LocaleNameNamesKeywordV1`, `LocaleNamePatternsPatternV1` |
| `locale-info` | quotation marks and exemplar characters of Locale | core | `LocaleInfoDelimitersV1`, `LocaleInfoExemplarsV1` |
| `regions` | the region containment of Locale.Region | core | `LocaleInfoRegionsV1` |
| `collation` | localized string comparison and sorting | core | `CollationRulesRootV1`, `CollationRulesTailoringV1` |
| `case-mapping` | case changes with a locale | core | `TextRulesCaseMappingV1` |
| `urls` | URL parsing of international host names | core | `TextInfoScriptV1`, `TextInfoBlockV1`, `URLRulesIDNAV1` |
| `encodings` | legacy text encodings | nothing | `EncodingTablesConvertersV1` |
| `windows` | Windows zone names and LCIDs | core | `TimeZoneInfoWindowsV1`, `LocaleInfoWindowsLCIDV1` |
| `calendar` | selected by the calendars setting, not by a feature setting | nothing | `DateNamesCyclic<Calendar>V1`, `DateNamesEra<Calendar>V1`, `DateNamesMonth<Calendar>V1`, `DatePatternsGlue<Calendar>V1`, `DatePatternsInterval<Calendar>V1`, `DatePatternsSkeleton<Calendar>V1`, `DatePatternsStyle<Calendar>V1`, `CalendarTablesJapaneseErasV1`, `CalendarTablesUmmAlQuraV1` |

Code that names its calendar as a type needs no `calendars` setting. With Foundation's value API, the setting is needed (`CONCEPT.md`, section 4).

## Not covered

These features are not in swift-foundation, so the source of this catalog does not show their data. A complete catalog for the Darwin Foundation would add them:

* Measurement formatting of all units (`Measurement.FormatStyle`, a stub in swift-foundation), so all unit names beyond digital and duration units.
* `Date.ComponentsFormatStyle` (a stub in swift-foundation).
* Text transforms (`applyingTransform`), text segmentation by words or sentences, morphology and inflection, person name formatting, number spell-out.
* Ordinal plural rules and plural ranges (not used in swift-foundation).

## Open questions

1. The data of the 10 calendars that public CLDR does not have (Bangla to Vietnamese): where does it come from?
2. The date patterns: this catalog keeps the CLDR model that Foundation uses today (styles, skeletons, the pattern generator), so that the output stays the same. ICU4X uses another model (semantic skeletons). Is that the right choice?
3. Kinds for each calendar: should non-Gregorian calendars store only their differences from a shared "generic" calendar, to save data? This catalog stores complete data, as ICU4X does.
4. Unicode data (bidi class, scripts, blocks, IDNA, case rules): should it be in this catalog, or does the Swift standard library provide it?
5. Collation: is one root kind and one tailoring kind enough, or should the root be split as in ICU4X (4 kinds)?
